_comment: P-TQA.7 — accepted/pre-existing high+critical advisories. The audit gate (scripts/auditGate.mjs) BLOCKS any high/critical NOT listed here. Each entry is triaged: dev-only, no safe fix, or a separate upgrade task. Re-triage periodically and remove once fixed. A NEW high/critical in any other package fails CI.

allow.reason: dev-only test runner (not shipped to users); fix requires a major-version bump tracked as a separate task.
dev-only coverage tool (P-TQA.1); same advisory as vitest (via: vitest) — fix is a semver-major vitest 4 upgrade tracked with the vitest entry. Never shipped to users.
dev/build-only toolchain (not shipped at runtime); upgrade tracked separately to avoid a risky major bump.
pre-existing transitive; upgrade evaluated separately (used server-side; needs regression check before bumping).
payments SDK; vendor-pinned — upgrade requires payment-flow re-verification, tracked separately.
transitive (fetch/runtime); pre-existing, upgrade tracked separately.
no upstream fix available on npm (prototype-pollution/ReDoS advisories); usage is server-side and input-controlled — tracked separately.

GHSA (RSC-mode CSRF bypass, range >=7.12.0 <8.3.0) applies ONLY to React Router's RSC/server-action mode; NavBharatAI is a Vite SPA using client-side routing (no RSC), so it is not exploitable. The only npm 'fix' is a breaking v8 major (>=8.3.0) or a downgrade to <7.12.0 which REINTRODUCES the 7.18.0-patched DoS (GHSA-chx6-hx7r-mcp5). Pinned at 7.18.1 (DoS-patched); v8 migration tracked separately.
Same advisory as react-router (via react-router). RSC-mode-only CSRF, not applicable to our SPA. Pinned at 7.18.1 (DoS-patched); v8 upgrade is a breaking major, tracked separately.

devDependency ONLY — the Firebase CLI, used locally/in CI to deploy Hosting config; never bundled into the built app (dist output ships zero firebase-tools code). Root cause is a fresh brace-expansion ReDoS advisory (ecosystem-wide, published independently of any dependency bump on this repo — confirmed via git history: the pinned version was already 15.18.0 at the last known-good state) that cascades through its whole dependency tree. npm's only 'fix' is a semver-major DOWNGRADE to 14.23.0 — not a real forward fix. Real fix (firebase-tools 15→16+ once it re-pins clean transitives) tracked separately; needs a deploy-flow regression check before bumping.
transitive of firebase-tools (devDependency, CLI-only, never shipped). Same brace-expansion cascade; fixAvailable is the firebase-tools major downgrade only. Tracked with the firebase-tools entry.

transitive of firebase-tools (devDependency, CLI-only, never shipped). Same brace-expansion cascade (via archiver-utils/readdir-glob/zip-stream); no safe forward fix without the firebase-tools major. Tracked with the firebase-tools entry.
transitive of firebase-tools (devDependency, CLI-only, never shipped), via glob. Same brace-expansion cascade; tracked with the firebase-tools entry.

root advisory of this cascade (ReDoS) — pulled in transitively by firebase-tools (devDependency, CLI-only, never shipped). No standalone safe bump; resolved only by the firebase-tools major, tracked separately.
transitive of firebase-tools (devDependency, CLI-only, never shipped), via glob. Same brace-expansion cascade; tracked with the firebase-tools entry.
transitive of firebase-tools (devDependency, CLI-only, never shipped), via exegesis. Same brace-expansion cascade; tracked with the firebase-tools entry.

transitive of firebase-tools (devDependency, CLI-only, never shipped), via rimraf/uuid. Same cascade; fixAvailable is a firebase-tools/firebase-admin major only. Tracked with the firebase-tools entry.

transitive of firebase-tools (devDependency, CLI-only, never shipped), via gaxios. A non-breaking fix technically exists for this package alone, but it is pinned by firebase-tools' own lockfile tree — an isolated bump risks breaking the CLI without a full firebase-tools upgrade. Tracked with the firebase-tools entry.
